main.description: Resolve a batch of post URIs for the caller, one item per URI. A post is returned only when the server can check that its author and the caller have no block; an author the caller has a block with gives a gap that says which way, and one the server cannot check gives 'block-state-unknown'. Requires auth as a member whose account is ready. Items carry no continuation markers.

items.description: One item per input URI, in input order.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Malformed request body, or too many URIs.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a member.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account is not ready yet.
